title: Penney’s Game
description: Race two coin-flip patterns and compare observed results with theoretical odds.

title: Pirate Council
description: Divide 100 coins, win the vote, and trace the crew’s incentives backward.

title: Bayesian Ratings
description: See how vote counts and a shared prior change a movie’s weighted score.

title: The 6174 Machine
description: Sort, subtract, and follow a four-digit number to its fixed point.

title: The Shock Generator
description: Sit at Milgram’s machine, feel the four prods, and compare where you stop with 40 real subjects.

title: The Razor Drawer
description: Pick the razor you would reach for, then meet the razors that reach the opposite conclusion from the same facts.
